action.description: 'block' raises an error; 'mask' replaces the code block with a placeholder.

blocked_languages.description: Language tags to block (e.g. python, javascript, bash). Empty or None = block all fenced code blocks.

confidence_threshold.description: Only block or mask when detection confidence >= this value; below threshold, allow or log_only.

detect_execution_intent.description: When True, block only when user intent is to run/execute; allow when intent is explain/refactor/don't run. Also block text-only execution requests (e.g. 'run `ls`', 'read /etc/passwd').
